src-readme|1.context: - Section → paragraph → sentence → citation → exact reference. Blocks retain source-file/line locators, original LaTeX, arbitrary fields and collapse state. Table rows and figure assets are also retained.

src-readme|2.context: **APA view** preserves the full section/paragraph structure and projects the same sentences with author–year citations and a reference list. Select a sentence to see tags, review and evidence (editable only in editing mode). Audit-only evidence links do not insert citations into manuscript prose. Switching views does not discard or rewrite blocks.

src-readme|3.context: Focus counts are unique visible reading blocks, including headings and visual blocks, not only sentences. Paragraph tags apply to their text; figure/table tags include their captions. A heading tag highlights the heading, not its whole section. Search narrows focus matches. Linked references stay prominent; evidence controls remain usable. No text is hidden, reordered, or rewritten. Focus and sidebar folds are session-only and do not alter saved document tags or exports. Printing restores full opacity. See [reading-focus verification](READING_FOCUS.md).

src-readme|4.context: - Quotes and bibliographic metadata are stored in shared source blocks. Editing a shared record updates every linked reference; it does not create inconsistent copies.

src-prompt|1.context: Make Fields controls available at EVERY hierarchy level. Fields reveal inline key:value rows like Tana or Logseq; these are not four separate forms or four boxed cards. Circular disclosure and add-child buttons demonstrate collapsing and extension of every block. The deepest quote has visual breathing room.
